g.text: The same view every other agent drives on.
How fast each gap is closing.
Which side is more open, and by how much.
How fast the walls stream past each eye:
the car's speed, and which wall is nearer.
The cues drive its visual detectors
MaleCNS v1.0 · 5 × 20 ms GPU substeps per step
One square per neuron: 656 left, 648 right, 10 midline
Each spike adds 1.0, then fades over 0.1 s,
so 0–3 spikes a step become a smooth
signal the readout can learn from.
Fitted once to expert driving, then fixed.
Learns from reward and from expert demos.
The trace is the policy's observation.
Acceleration comes first. Swap them and
steering ends up on the throttle.
Then the car moves, the rays change and
the brain takes its next step.

svg.text: The Unity gym sends 31 numbers every tenth
The same view our conventional driving
